ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_TRANSACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
Procedure commit_transaction is
--temp_id VARCHAR2 (10) ; --- SCR 18714 Changes
temp_id VARCHAR2 (13) ;
tmp_order_no VARCHAR2(10);
Begin
 check_quantity; -- Added by Kishore on 07/28/2015
 :GLOBAL.today_date := to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS');
 begin
 select fi_company_no into :GLOBAL.fi_company
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.fi_company := '1';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get service code for product
 --
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_tran_type='CR' then
 generate_number('C','M',temp_id);
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_advice_id := temp_id;
 else
 generate_number('D','M',temp_id);
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_advice_id := temp_id;
 end if;
 message ('Please note the advice_id :'||temp_id);
 --if :s_patient_name is not null then -- Commented by Kishore on 11/06/2014. SCR 20867
 Begin
 insert into order_patients (
 ORDER_NO, CHAPTER_ID, PATIENT_NAME )
 values (temp_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :s_patient_name);
 exception when others then handle_error; check_package_failure;
 end;
 --end if; -- Commented by Kishore on 11/06/2014. SCR 20867
 go_block('customer_dbcr_adjust');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 check_package_failure;
 if :order_no is not null then
 begin
 select orders.order_no,
 to_char(orders.insert_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
 into tmp_order_no, :GLOBAL.order_date from orders
 where order_no=:order_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 exception when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.order_date:=to_char(to_date(
 :GLOBAL.today_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS'),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 when others then null;
 end;
 else
 :GLOBAL.order_date:=to_char(to_date(
 :GLOBAL.today_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS'),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 end if;
 :tran_type:=:ctrl_blk_1.s_tran_type;
 :chapter_id:=:GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :advice_id:=:ctrl_blk_1.s_advice_id;
 :insert_date:=
 to_rrdate(to_char(sysdate, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'), 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 :insert_user_id:=:banner.user_id;
 :customer_dbcr_adjust.customer_id:=:s_customer_id;
 :GLOBAL.service_code:=:customer_dbcr_adjust.service_code;
 if :order_no is null then
 :order_no:=:advice_id;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_tran_type='CR' then
 credit_customer;
 else
 debit_customer;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 then
 next_record;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 gen_report('CSRDCLST', :ctrl_blk_1.s_advice_id);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREDIT_CUSTOMER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure credit_customer is
 credit_ar_account VARCHAR2(20);
 shipment_no VARCHAR2(14);
 shipped_date Date;
 error_flag varchar2(1);
 attribute_found varchar2(1);
 usrtext2 varchar2(24);
 item_id varchar2(12);
 price_no varchar2(2);
 err_key VARCHAR2(70);
 patient_name varchar2(24);
 standard_price number(9,2);
 flag1 varchar2(1);
 tmpunit varchar2(15);
 today_date date;
 order_date date; 
 temp_price number;
begin
 if :amount is null then
 begin
 select charge into temp_price
 from vserv_charge_codes
 where service_code=:service_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 exception when no_data_found then
 message('No records in vserv_charge_codes....');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 standard_price := to_number(temp_price);
 :amount:=standard_price;
 else
 standard_price := :amount;
 end if;
 item_id := :GLOBAL.service_code;
 tmpunit := '';
 patient_name := :s_patient_name;
 usrtext2 := substr(:service_code||'-'
 || ' ' ,1,24);
 --
 -- Get credit_ar_accout from customer table
 --
 begin
 select ar_account into credit_ar_account
 from customers
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get Fi_Price_Sch_No
 --
 begin
 price_no := '00';
 end;
 --
 -- Get the shipment number
 --
 shipment_no:=:ctrl_blk_1.s_advice_id;
-- shipped_date:=to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 shipped_date := sysdate;
 err_key := substr(shipment_no||'-'||:customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no||'-'||
 credit_ar_account,1,70);
 today_date := to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.today_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI:SS');
 order_date := to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.order_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 check_duplicate_order_no(:customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,
 :Global.fi_company, today_date, flag1);
 if flag1 = 'N' -- new order, not duplicate
 then
 billing_interface.insert_header(:GLOBAL.fi_company,
 :customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,
 credit_ar_account,
 shipment_no,
 shipped_date,
 order_date,
 today_date,
 error_flag);
 if error_flag = 'E'
 then
 message('Error inserting into billing_interface hdr');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 billing_interface.insert_invoice_details
 (:GLOBAL.fi_company,
 :customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no, ---substr(:customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,1,10), MLT 4147
 credit_ar_account,
 item_id,
 shipped_date,
 standard_price,
 today_date,
 patient_name,
 usrtext2,
 tmpunit,
 price_no,
 'CREDIT ADJUSTMENT',
 (-1)*:customer_dbcr_adjust.quantity,
 (-1)*:customer_dbcr_adjust.quantity,
 'CR', :advice_id,
 error_flag);
 if error_flag = 'E'
 then
 message('Error in insert_invoice_details ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 -- See if unit has any attribute
 --
end;

begin
 if :amount is null then
 begin
 select charge into temp_price

 If temp_count = 0 then

 insert into rpt_parm_select

 then

 copy('5','system.message_level');

FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;

begin

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :customer_dbcr_adjust.note_id is not null then
 go_block('note');
 go_record(1);
 loop
 if :note.note_id=:customer_dbcr_adjust.note_id then
 clear_record;
 exit;
 else
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_block('customer_dbcr_adjust');
 end if;
 clear_record;
end;
